name: Dallas Morning News editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the paper Center. Historically center-right board that recommends candidates of both parties; in Dallas County races its 2026 picks so far are 5 Democrats and 3 Republicans, with no pick in two races (DA and SBOE 9).

name: League of Women Voters of Dallas
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; its guide says the League never supports or opposes any candidate or political party. Prints candidates' unedited answers and lists reasons for and against each measure.

name: Dallas County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its November page lists the Democrats on the ballot (a nominee roster, not a separate endorsement vote).

name: Dallas County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its Meet the Candidates page lists Republican nominees but states "These are not endorsements."

name: North Texas Area Labor Federation (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO federation (the old Dallas AFL-CIO Council links now point to it). All 12 of its Dallas County local picks are Democrats; it says an unlisted race means delegates made no recommendation.

name: Stonewall Democrats of Dallas
lean_basis: LGBTQ+ Democratic club. Every pick on its 2026 general slate (as mirrored by Blue Voter Guide, citing the group's Facebook posts) is a Democrat.

name: Dallas Regional Chamber
lean_basis: Regional business chamber; no AllSides rating. This guide rates big-city chambers lean right (as with the Greater Austin Chamber). No candidate endorsements were found; its 2026 posts cover the two Dallas Prop A measures.

name: Dallas Police Association
lean_basis: Police officers' union; no AllSides rating. This guide rates big-city police associations lean right (as with the Austin Police Association). Its own site could not be reached; its 2026 position comes from FOX 4 reporting.
